<function name="FillFileInfo" parent="WorkshopFileBase" type="classfunc">
	<description>
		Updates the set HTML panel with the newly fetched results
	</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="results" type="table">The type to search for. (`local`, `subscribed`, `subscribed_ugc`, `mine`, `favorite`)</arg>
		<arg name="isUGC" type="boolean">Skips the first x results.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
